answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the kernel log publishes the live set and the tundra audit records each lapse. Keeping 43 aliases alive hence means 43 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the delta quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 776 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
